tools.name: scan_content
tools.description: Screen marketing copy for regulated-health advertising compliance (addiction treatment, ketamine, psilocybin, cannabis, and related verticals) against Pre-Trip's curated, source-cited rulesets. Use this whenever the user is drafting or about to publish a health-marketing email, landing page, blog post, or social post, or asks to check copy for compliance. Returns a pass, or a fix list where each flag quotes the exact line, names the rule, and cites the statute. This is a screen, not legal advice. Call get_coverage first if unsure which vertical or state values are valid.

content.description: The marketing copy to check. Plain text or HTML.

asset_type.description: The kind of asset being scanned.

state.description: Two-letter US state code you are marketing into, e.g. CA.

vertical.description: The regulated vertical, e.g. addiction_treatment, ketamine, cannabis. Use get_coverage for the exact list.

covered_entity.description: True if the advertiser is a HIPAA covered entity (most clinics that bill insurance or hold patient records).

subject.description: Email subject and preview text. Email only.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Return the verticals, asset types, and states Pre-Trip covers, so scan_content can be called with valid values. Call this when unsure which vertical or state to pass.
